summary: JD.com, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. Net revenues were RMB315.7 billion (+4.9% YoY), with net income attributable to ordinary shareholders of RMB5.1 billion and non-GAAP net income of RMB7.4 billion. Diluted net income per ADS was RMB3.54 (non-GAAP: RMB5.12). The release includes segment highlights for JD Retail and New Businesses, and notes share repurchases of ~1.6% of total shares outstanding for US$631 million. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement under cover of Form 6-K, mapping to a US quarterly earnings press release. No special-situation classification applies.
